title: Measure where this operation's tokens go: models per role, context size, and waste
why: Owner ask ask-mw83yebd18 (11:30 CST Nov 8): "what is causing so much token spend in general in this operation given that so much should be running on sonnet? is there a lot of context waste? token waste? more opus than anticipated? we've spent thousands more than i'd expect for this kind of work". Unmeasured today. Done when a report gives, for one day, spend by model and by role (coordinator, triage, runners, lanes, agents), the share of Opus against the agent-model-cap table, and the largest context sources (long sessions, re-read files, transcripts), each with its source.
